_readme: Handpicked audio library. Drop files in public/sfx and public/music, then add an entry here
describing each one. The director picks the music bed by mood from 'tags' + 'use'; 'file' is
relative to public/. MUSIC: 'lufs' = the file's measured integrated loudness — the bot sets
the bed's level from it so every track lands ~16 dB under the normalised voice (bot/src/lib/
loudness.ts mixLevels; studio/src/auto/bed.ts shapes it over time). Measure a new file with
`ffmpeg -i x.mp3 -af ebur128 -f null -` (the I: line); unmeasured files are assumed -14.
Tracks with 'source: mixkit' are from mixkit.co (Mixkit License: free for commercial and social
use, no attribution), trimmed to <=100 s with a fade, slow intros cut so the groove starts at 0.
SFX = the v4 kit (public/sfx/v4): real recorded sounds from mixkit.co (same license), trimmed and
level-matched to -20 LUFS max-momentary. WorldReel places them itself via src/auto/sound.ts
(see src/auto/SOUND.md); 'volume' is the level for the v2 renderer's director-placed cues
(~11 dB under the voice). 'hitMs' = where the sound lands inside the file. 'sfx_legacy' =
older kits kept only so older props still resolve; don't pick them.

sfx.use: clean fast air sweep (0.75s, peaks at 0.28s) — a cut / scene change / something sliding in
a shorter, slightly brighter sweep (0.6s, peaks at 0.28s) — the same job as sweep-a, for variety
very short wind swoosh (0.45s, peaks at 0.16s) — a quick snap between two things
modern UI select click — a checkmark, a step completing, a toggle, a cursor click
softer UI click — the NEXT check/step right after click-select
round pop — a card / logo / object appearing
a few keyboard taps (0.85s) — ONCE as a terminal/code/prompt starts typing
one key click — a keyboard shortcut / kbd moment
short confirmation tone — the payoff: the link/result lands, 'get it here', done
short bass hit — a big number landing, a stat, a one-word punch
a 1s sweep that builds into a hit (lands at 0.95s) — into a reveal/comparison; at most one per video
digital camera shutter — a real screenshot of a site/post appearing

sfx_legacy.use: soft filtered-air swish (0.67s, peaks at 0.26s) — a camera move / scene change, centred; darkens as it lands
same air swish panned in from the right — camera travelling right / content entering from the right
same air swish panned in from the left — camera travelling left / content entering from the left
tiny glassy UI tick (0.16s) — a checkmark landing, a step completing, a toggle flipping, a cursor click
the same tick two semitones up — the NEXT check/step right after tick-a (never the same sample twice in a row)
round soft bloop (0.3s) — a card/object arriving on screen when there's no camera move to carry it
three soft low-profile key taps (0.42s) — ONCE as a terminal/code/prompt starts typing; never loop it into a typing track
one soft key press + release (0.22s) — a keyboard shortcut / kbd moment
gentle two-note rising chime, D5→A5 (0.7s) — the payoff: the link/result lands, 'get it here', done
low felt thump with a soft knock (0.55s) — a big number settling, a stat, a one-word punch; not a cinematic boom
0.9s filtered-air rise that stops ON the hit — into a reveal/comparison after a pause; at most one per video
LEGACY stock whoosh (5.6s file, ~1.1s lead silence, -14.8 LUFS) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock click — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock pop (4.9s file) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock riser (-7.4 LUFS, ~1.8s lead silence) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock typing loop (4.8s) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock thud — brick-walled (-0.8 LUFS, DC offset); kept for old renders only, never use

music.use: default bed for dry/relaxed scripts
drifting, spacious pads — cold-open / futuristic / research-frontier scripts; stays out of the way
darker evening mood — drama, bans, layoffs, 'something changed' scripts; pairs with red/violet accents
safe neutral bed — explainers, tool walkthroughs, anything that shouldn't editorialize the mood
rainy-window cozy — reflective / 'here's what I actually think' scripts; slowest of the set
study-beats focus loop — install / setup / how-to / 'watch it work' tool demos; steady pulse keeps typing beats moving
warmest + most upbeat of the set — wins, launches, 'this is great' recommendations; pairs with green/orange accents
modern electronica with a steady drive — launches, big tool drops, 'this changes things' energy
bright electronic pop — fun tool demos, 'look what this does' scripts
clean uplifting corporate electronic — product announcements, company news, neutral-positive
optimistic synthpop — wins, good news, 'the future is here' takes
electropop that builds gently — 'something is shifting' stories, trend explainers
airy chill electronic — research, AI concepts, calm explainers
soft steady chillout — thoughtful takes, tutorials that need a calm bed
cozy relaxed chillout — easy tool tips, low-stakes recommendations
lofi beat with a steady pulse — how-tos, setup walkthroughs, 'watch it work'
smooth late-night lofi — reflective scripts, personal takes
smooth confident groove — productivity tools, workflow scripts
futuristic dark ambient — AI risk, security, leaks, 'this is getting wild'
mysterious night electronic — investigations, hidden features, deep dives
moody electronica — serious news: layoffs, bans, lawsuits, big model drama
sci-fi score feel — frontier research, AGI talk, huge model releases
laid-back lofi hip-hop beat — casual tool finds, 'you need to try this'
confident hip-hop beat — hype tools, money/side-hustle angles, bold claims
